Redraw all ten, same order and layout, as true 2D cartoon characters, NOT 3D: flat colour fills, clean smooth coloured outlines (a darker tone of each part's fill, never black), exactly one hard-edged cel shadow tone on the lower-right side of each part, a small flat highlight shape, big simple cartoon eyes (dark oval with a large white catchlight and a small second one), flat pink cheek ovals, simplified friendly shapes like a modern 2D animated series or premium sticker set. No gradients, no textures, no fur strands, no 3D lighting, no drop shadows except a flat soft oval on the floor. Each full body, frontal, standing, keep each character's colours and signature details from the reference. Plain very light grey background, landscape, generous spacing, no text, no labels, no watermark.
